create.name: Medito
create.bio:
Medito is a meditation app made by the Medito Foundation, a non-profit registered in the Netherlands and launched in 2020. Everything in it is free: there is no subscription, no premium tier, no advertising and no need to create an account. The app's code is open source, and much of the work is done by volunteers from around the world, with the foundation funded by donations.

The practice content is mainly secular mindfulness. It includes guided meditations for beginners and more experienced practitioners, short courses and three thirty-day challenges (one on mindfulness, one on compassion and one on becoming more active), a fresh guided session each day, breathing exercises, and an unguided timer with ambient sounds. Users can choose between different narrators' voices. The foundation develops its material with mindfulness researchers and experienced teachers and works with universities on studies of its programmes. Its website also carries plain introductory guides to meditation, such as a step-by-step page for newcomers that starts with five minutes of attention to the breath.

free_resources.title: Meditation for Beginners
free_resources.description: A free step-by-step guide on the foundation's site for starting a daily practice, beginning with five minutes of resting attention on the breath. It answers common first-week worries, such as busy thoughts or not knowing whether you are doing it right.
